title: Build a RAG Agent
subtitle: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with AWS Bedrock + Chroma
description: Wire up a working RAG agent end to end: embed a knowledge base with Amazon Titan, store and search it in a local Chroma vector DB, and let a LangGraph ReAct agent answer questions with citations.

title: Build a ReAct Agent
subtitle: Reason + Act + Observe loop with tool use, from scratch
description: Build the loop every agent framework hides. An LLM emits a Thought, picks an Action, your code runs the tool and feeds back an Observation, and the LLM continues until it returns a Final Answer.

title: Build an MCP Server
subtitle: Expose tools and resources through an inspectable protocol server
description: Build the core of an MCP server in Python. Describe tools, expose resources, validate model-supplied arguments, dispatch calls, and run a complete JSON-RPC client transcript.

title: Sparse Autoencoder Feature Lab
subtitle: Build sparse features, inspect evidence, and test interventions.
description: Implement a small sparse autoencoder from supplied activation samples, then investigate a compatible pretrained SAE using feature examples, counterexamples, and controlled ablations.

title: Build an RL Environment
subtitle: Build a grid world, watch an agent exploit a bad reward, and fix it.
description: Build a reinforcement learning environment from scratch, test it before training, see an agent exploit a badly designed reward, fix the reward so it cannot be farmed, and judge results honestly across many random seeds.

title: Build an LLM Serving Scheduler
subtitle: Batch requests, manage the KV cache, and measure speed and waiting time.
description: Build the scheduler of an LLM server: attention with a KV cache, continuous batching, latency metrics, KV cache sizing, and a paged block allocator, then serve real traffic and fix the stalls long prompts cause.

title: Write a Matrix Multiply Kernel in Triton
subtitle: Write real Triton kernels, then count why tiling, grouping and fusion make them fast.
description: Write Triton kernels for a vector add and a tiled matrix multiply, guard edge tiles with masks, count the global memory traffic of each tiling, estimate speed with a roofline model, launch tiles in a cache-friendly order, and fuse a bias and ReLU into the kernel.

title: Build an Object Detector's Back Half
subtitle: Turn raw detector outputs into boxes with IoU, matching, NMS, and mAP.
description: Write everything that happens after a detector network: box formats and IoU, decoding anchor offsets into boxes, matching anchors to objects for training, class-aware NMS, and average precision computed the way COCO does.

title: Fit a Model in Less Memory
subtitle: Measure where training memory goes, then cut it with checkpointing, quantization and LoRA.
description: Count the bytes of weights, gradients, optimizer state and activations, plan activation checkpoints, quantize weights to int8 with absmax scales, and size a LoRA fine-tune, then measure all of it on a real PyTorch model.

title: Write FlashAttention Step by Step
subtitle: Compute attention in tiles with a running softmax and prove it matches.
description: Build FlashAttention step by step: safe and online softmax, merging partial results, tiled and causal attention that match PyTorch exactly, an exact count of the memory traffic that makes it fast, and the same algorithm as a Triton kernel.

title: Classify Research Papers by Their Citations
subtitle: Train a graph neural network that labels papers using the papers they cite.
description: Build a graph neural network in PyTorch that predicts the topic of a research paper from its words and its citation links: score a split, build the normalized adjacency matrix, write GCN and neighbor-mean layers, and measure how deeper networks make every paper look alike.

title: Train a Tiny CLIP from Scratch
subtitle: Train image and text encoders that agree, then search and classify with them.
description: Train an image encoder and a text encoder into one shared space with the contrastive loss, search captions with pictures, classify with written prompts, prove the model ignores which color goes with which shape, and fix it with hard negatives.

title: Build a Tiny Vision Transformer
subtitle: Read an image as a sequence of patches, then find out when a CNN still wins.
description: Build a Vision Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: cut images into patches, add a class token and positions, write attention and a pre-norm transformer block, measure how far each head looks, and compare it honestly with a CNN on Fashion-MNIST.

title: Quantize a Language Model to 4 Bits
subtitle: Store a language model in 8 and 4 bits, find what breaks, and fix it.
description: Quantize with scales and zero points, group-wise int4 with protected channels, SmoothQuant factors, GPTQ error feedback, NF4 levels and a quantized KV cache, then measure every method on a real language model.

title: Train an Agent with PPO
subtitle: Collect experience, estimate advantages, and update a policy with PPO's clipped objective.
description: Build PPO from scratch in PyTorch: discounted returns across episode boundaries, GAE advantages, the clipped surrogate objective, the approximate KL and clip fraction, and the complete minibatch loss. Then train an agent on CartPole, compare it with REINFORCE across seeds, and diagnose what happens when the clipping is removed.

title: Build Hybrid Attention for Long Context
subtitle: Mix cheap attention layers with a few full ones and measure memory against recall.
description: Build the layers long-context models are made of: a sliding window mask, grouped-query attention, linear attention as a running state and the gated delta rule, then count exactly how much cache any mix of layers keeps.

title: Split Training Across Many Workers
subtitle: Count the bytes, memory and idle time of every way to split training.
description: Compare ring all-reduce with a parameter server, simulate the ring, size ZeRO memory per worker, schedule a pipeline and measure its bubble, split an MLP with tensor parallelism, and write the DiLoCo outer step.

title: Build a Tiny GPT from Scratch
subtitle: Turn Shakespeare into tokens, build a decoder-only transformer, train it, and make it write.
description: Build a character-level GPT from scratch in PyTorch: a byte pair encoding merge, the next-token loss, causal self-attention, multi-head attention, the sampling filter with temperature, top-k and top-p, and the parameter count of a whole model. Then train it on Shakespeare and remove the causal mask to see why it matters.

title: Build an AlphaZero-Style Game Player
subtitle: Combine tree search with a policy-value network and improve it through self-play.
description: Build the pieces of AlphaZero for tic-tac-toe in plain Python: the game rules, a minimax solver, the PUCT selection score, policy targets from visit counts, and the full select, expand, evaluate and back up loop, then use them in a PyTorch notebook that trains a policy-value network by self-play.

title: Align a Language Model with DPO
subtitle: Turn preference pairs into a loss and align a small language model without a reward model.
description: Score replies by their log-probability, write the DPO loss and its implicit rewards, log reward accuracy and margin, write the IPO loss, and measure drift with per-token KL divergence.

title: Generate Images with Diffusion and Rectified Flow
subtitle: Add noise, learn to remove it, then find out what happens when you only have a few steps.
description: Build DDPM and rectified flow from scratch in PyTorch: noise schedules, the one-jump forward process, the noise-prediction loss, reverse steps, Euler sampling and few-step DDPM sampling, on a 2D spiral and on small clothing images.

title: Train a Reasoning Model with GRPO
subtitle: Reward only answers a program can check, and train a small model to solve them with GRPO.
description: Score answers with a program instead of a reward model, sample a group of answers per prompt, turn rewards into group-relative advantages, write the clipped GRPO loss with a KL penalty, watch a lenient checker get hacked, fix it, and measure what training changed with pass at k.

title: Plan with a Learned World Model
subtitle: Learn how a world behaves from random experience, then plan inside the model.
description: Build model-based reinforcement learning in PyTorch: turn episodes into training pairs, measure how imagined rollouts drift, plan with random shooting and the cross-entropy method, and score plans with an ensemble so the planner stops exploiting what the model got wrong.

title: Build a Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
subtitle: Route each token to a few experts, keep the load balanced, and compare it with a dense model of equal compute.
description: Build a mixture-of-experts layer from scratch in PyTorch: top-k routing, dispatch and combine, total versus active parameters, expert capacity, the Switch balancing loss and router z-loss, and the bias-based balancing of DeepSeek-V3. Then train a tiny character language model (an MLP over the last 8 characters) with it and watch the router collapse without balancing in this setup.
